title: PHerc0826 ink render: the recipe fit, the winding-model refit, and the second-generation refits with the phase term on the model's or the CT-snapped crossings (ink_9um, every 5th winding)
notes: PHerc0826 (First Letters eligible), z [8928, 9728). The First Letters recipe fits windings that do not follow the sheets, and a render along such a winding crosses several sheets, so an ink model is unlikely to show text on it. This notebook renders every 5th winding of the recipe fit, of the winding-model refit W48 (as fitted and moved onto the sheets with tools/phase_align.py (crest mode: to the nearest crest of the CT, period 17 voxels)) and of the second-generation refits (notebook pherc0826-winding-model-supervision-gen2-phase), and runs the public ink_9um model on them, after checking the render + ink chain on a curated segment with published labels.
